findings.fact: Front-matter evidence checkers expose --enforce but integration runners invoke audit mode, so aggregate PASS can contain normative FAIL records.
frontmatter-approval-evidence.sh substitutes 'tipo = tese' although the canonical fixture uses 'type = doctoral-thesis'; the profile substitution is a no-op.
source_body_paragraphs excludes legacy/upstream keyword macros but not canonical \ufcSummaryKeywords, causing a false two-paragraph observation.
dedication.line-spacing reports 41.4 pt against same-document calibrated 20.7 pt; runtime changes are forbidden until discrimination.
epigraph.short.alignment reports FAIL; the short route does not explicitly apply the justification setup used by other routes, but current evidence is not sufficient to classify a runtime defect.
title-page and approval evidence report missing/undetected nature/advisor markers and require robust extraction review after fixture repair.
normative_coverage proves that rules name known checks, not that those checks enforce the predicates.
17 rules are manual or conditional and must be individually justified rather than assumed to be automation debt.
v3_api_residual scans selected LaTeX/runtime sources but not project-owned shell/Python/workflow/machine generators, allowing stale v2 literals in scripts.
Portuguese project-owned technical diagnostics remain in integration scripts while repository_contract enforces mainly path-level language constraints.
front-matter scenario/applicability machine identifiers remain Portuguese although canonical runtime type values are English.
v3-api-migration is a live residual-gate dependency; v3-test-migration and v3-path-migration require a final consumer audit before consolidation/removal.
